## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and affected area(s) A–E.

## Interfaces and data

List changed routes, event schemas, ownership, configuration or migrations and the members who need to coordinate. State when none change.

## Validation

Record actual commands/results and integration checks. Label checks not run; link evidence without secrets or tokens.

## Review

- [ ] At least one reviewer with write access other than the PR author approved, or the repository owner explicitly used admin bypass.
- [ ] Relevant area owners provided feedback where needed.
- [ ] Appropriate tests passed and the documented boot path still works.
- [ ] Consumer/provider changes are coordinated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, runtime data, dependencies or build output are committed.
- [ ] OWNERS evidence and docs are updated where relevant.
